problem 解説と位置付け 解説章を読む この例の前提 固定格子・固定ゼロDirichlet境界の滑らかなBratu下側分枝を用い、状態ヤコビ行列が局所的に可逆である。 新しい空間係数はλ(x)=a+b(2x−1)、a∈[1,2.8]、b∈[−0.5,0.5]であり、以前の定数λモデルを拡張する。 合成観測と正の重みを固定し、パラメータの尺度・事前値・正則化強度を明記する。データだけの感度行列の階数と、正則化後の系の階数を区別する。 境界条件: u(0)=u(1)=0を両係数に依存せず固定し、観測位置も区間[0,1]内で固定する。 単位系: 状態・座標・係数は無次元。観測重みとパラメータ尺度を明記し、特異値と正則化強度の尺度依存を区別する。 Bratuの逆問題：随伴勾配によるλ推定の専用配布版 定数λを1個推定する既存配布版です。同じ離散化での回復、連続解析解からの観測、固定摂動を分けて検証します。2パラメータの拡張は次の別配布版で扱います。 取得・実行手順 / README · コード・検査・観測データ・図 ZIP · ファイル目録・SHA-256 · 23件成功・検証記録 numart/bratu_inverse.py Other names: 数値最適化 / 勾配降下法 / 準Newton法 / 準ニュートン法 / gradient descent / quasi Newton / Bratu / λ推定 / パラメータ推定 / 逆問題 / inverse problem / parameter identification / projected gradient / Armijo / 複数パラメータ推定 / 正則化 / 識別可能性 / Tikhonov regularization / identifiability / singular values / multi-parameter inverse problem Read the formulation Read the chapter Assumptions for this example Smooth lower-branch Bratu states on a fixed mesh with a locally nonsingular state Jacobian and fixed zero Dirichlet data. The new spatial coefficient is lambda(x)=a+b(2x-1), with a in [1,2.8] and b in [-0.5,0.5]; this extends the earlier constant-lambda model. Fixed synthetic observations, positive weights and explicitly stated parameter scales, priors and regularization strengths; data-only sensitivity rank is separate from a regularized system rank. Boundaries: u(0)=u(1)=0 independent of both coefficients; fixed observation locations on [0,1]. Units: Dimensionless state, coordinate and coefficients. Observation weights and parameter scales are explicit; singular values and regularization strengths depend on those scales. Bratu inverse problem: adjoint-gradient parameter fitting The existing edition fits one constant lambda and distinguishes same-discretization recovery, continuous analytic observations and fixed perturbations. The following separate edition provides the two-parameter extension. 取得・実行手順 / README · Code, tests, observations and figure ZIP · File manifest / SHA-256 · 23 tests passed / verification numart/bratu_inverse.py numart/bratu_sensitivity.py numart/autodiff.py numart/krylov.py scripts/build_bratu_inverse.py tests/test_bratu_inverse.py Adjoint gradients, fit histories, grid bias and fixed-noise records / JSON python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q tests/test_bratu_inverse.py python scripts/build_bratu_inverse.py MIT License · 適用範囲 / Licensing scope Multi-parameter Bratu inversion: regularization and identifiability Educational tests use small smooth lower-branch Bratu problems and fixed synthetic observations. They cover two spatial coefficients, Tikhonov regularization, local data-sensitivity SVD, rank loss with central observations and reflection ambiguity. Prior selection through regularization does not add observational information. Real data, high-dimensional function estimation, global uniqueness, statistical confidence intervals and quasi-Newton methods generally are outside scope. 取得・実行手順 / README · Code, tests, observations and figure ZIP · File manifest / SHA-256 · 30 tests passed / verification numart/bratu_multinverse.py numart/bratu_inverse.py numart/bratu_sensitivity.py numart/autodiff.py numart/krylov.py scripts/build_bratu_multinverse.py tests/test_bratu_multinverse.py Coefficient fits, regularization, data-sensitivity SVD and ambiguity records / JSON python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q tests/test_bratu_multinverse.py python scripts/build_bratu_multinverse.py MIT License · 適用範囲 / Licensing scope Scope and remaining work Educational tests use small smooth lower-branch Bratu problems and fixed synthetic observations.
